table.name: Examination
table.purpose: Clinical examination/visit record for a rheumatology/autoimmune-disease cohort (mostly SLE, Sjögren's, RA, MCTD patients), capturing visit date, lab/serology findings, ANA results, diagnosis, and disease complications.

col_001.name: patient_id
col_001.description: Likely a patient identifier (7-digit hospital-style ID, near-unique across rows). No joins detected to Patient/Laboratory, so the link is not confirmed; could alternatively be a visit/exam record number.

col_002.name: examination_date
col_002.description: Date of the examination/visit, ranging 1989-04-18 to 1998-04-17.

col_003.name: crp
col_003.description: A lab value with median 0.8 and values like 17.3, 59.6 — plausibly C-reactive protein (mg/dL), where 0 is normal. Max 2150.3 is an outlier or different unit. Not confirmed; could be another inflammatory marker.

col_005.name: ana_titer
col_005.description: Values are exclusively powers of two (0, 4, 16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096), the classic pattern of an immunofluorescence antibody titer (e.g., ANA titer expressed as reciprocal dilution); 0 = negative/not done.

col_006.name: ana_pattern
col_006.description: Comma-separated codes S, P, D (also lowercase 'p', and 'P.D' typo) — plausibly ANA staining patterns: S = speckled, P = peripheral/rim, D = diffuse/homogeneous. Multiple patterns can co-occur. Not confirmed against a lookup.

col_008.name: diagnosis
col_008.description: Diagnosis at examination: SLE, SjS (Sjögren's), RA, MCTD, DM, plus qualifiers like 'WHOIV' (WHO class IV lupus nephritis), 'ITP', 'LA(-)', 'susp' (suspected).

col_012.name: complications
col_012.description: Disease complications/comorbid events: CNS lupus, brain infarction, AMI, PH (pulmonary hypertension), thrombocytopenia, DVT, thrombophlebitis, abortion, etc. Mostly null (no complication).

col_013.name: complication_count
col_013.description: Small count 0-3, mostly 0 — plausibly the number of complications recorded for the visit (matches col_012 being mostly null). Could alternatively be a severity grade.

table.name: Laboratory
table.purpose: Laboratory results (blood chemistry, hematology and urinalysis panels) per patient visit, linked to Patient; the birth dates (1981-1999) and value ranges suggest a pediatric (likely nephrology) cohort, since many columns (urea, creatinine, complement, urine dipstick, urine culture) fit kidney-disease workups. One row = one patient's lab panel on one occasion.

col_001.name: patient_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the patient; references Patient.col_001 (many lab rows per patient).

col_002.name: date_of_birth
col_002.description: Patient date of birth (all values 1981-1999, consistent with a pediatric cohort).

col_005.description: Integer, median 295, range 25-67080. Distribution resembles a blood count (e.g. platelets x10^3/uL) but the huge maximum leaves this uncertain.

col_007.name: urine_ph
col_007.description: Values cluster 6.7-7.6 within 0-9.9, exactly the urine pH scale; likely urine dipstick pH.

col_010.name: age_years
col_010.description: Median 14, bulk 11-17, consistent with patient age in years given 1981-1999 births; a few large outliers (max 152) argue against certainty.

col_013.description: Integer, median 198, range 37-568. Could be total cholesterol or glucose (mg/dL); both fit the distribution.

col_016.name: blood_glucose
col_016.description: Median 102, range 62-499, 88% null; distribution fits fasting/random blood glucose in mg/dL, but sparseness weakens the evidence.

col_017.name: urea
col_017.description: Median 7.0, range 0.9-35.2 mmol/L; fits serum urea (elevated in renal patients). Could also be another nitrogen waste analyte.

col_018.name: potassium
col_018.description: Median 4.3, range 0.4-6.6; classic serum potassium (mmol/L) distribution.

col_019.name: hemoglobin
col_019.description: Median 12.5, range 1.3-18.9 g/dL; typical hemoglobin concentration.

col_020.name: hematocrit
col_020.description: Median 38.1, range 3.0-56.0; consistently ~3x col_019, i.e. packed cell volume (%).

col_021.name: platelet_count
col_021.description: Median 248, range 5-5844 (x10^3/uL); fits platelet count with thrombocytosis outliers, though extreme maxima leave some doubt.

col_028.name: urine_glucose_dipstick
col_028.description: Semiquantitative codes: '-' (negative), 'TR' (trace), numeric gradings and '>=1000' (mg/dL) — pattern of a urine glucose dipstick.

col_030.name: tibc
col_030.description: Sparse, median 343, range 1-1765; fits total iron binding capacity (ug/dL), but could be another binding-protein measure.

col_031.name: serum_iron
col_031.description: Sparse, median 152, range 0-1573; plausibly serum iron (ug/dL) completing an iron panel with col_029/col_030, but identity uncertain.

col_032.name: urine_protein
col_032.description: Mixed qualitative/quantitative: '-', '<0.3', '<0.2', '+', '2+' — pattern of a urine protein (dipstick/quantification) result.

col_033.name: urine_dipstick_qualitative
col_033.description: Values '-', '+', '2+', '+-' — a qualitative dipstick grade (e.g. ketones or bilirubin); specific strip parameter unknown.

col_035.name: complement_c3
col_035.description: Median 69, range 15-196, 61% null; fits serum C3 (low in glomerulonephritis), but could be another protein.

col_036.name: complement_c4
col_036.description: Median 21, range 3-80; fits serum C4, paired with col_035; identity uncertain.

col_037.name: microbiology_titer_1
col_037.description: Values 'negative', 0, and powers of two (1,4,16,64,256) — semiquantitative culture/serology titers. One of a block of six similar columns (col_037-col_042), likely organism-specific results; individual identities unknown.

col_038.name: microbiology_titer_2
col_038.description: Same pattern as col_037 ('negative', 0, 1, 2, 8); specific organism/test unknown.

col_039.name: microbiology_titer_3
col_039.description: Same pattern as col_037 ('negative', 0, 1, 4, 16); specific test unknown.

col_040.name: microbiology_titer_4
col_040.description: Same pattern as col_037 ('negative', 0, 1, 16, 64); specific test unknown.

col_041.name: microbiology_titer_5
col_041.description: Same pattern as col_037 ('negative', 0, 1, 2, 32); specific test unknown.

col_042.name: microbiology_titer_6
col_042.description: Same pattern as col_037 ('negative', 0); specific test unknown.

table.name: Patient
table.purpose: Rheumatology patient registry: one row per patient, with demographics, diagnosis dates, a serology flag, and diagnoses (SLE, Sjögren's, RA, Behçet's, PSS etc.). Referenced by Laboratory results.

col_001.name: patient_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique patient identifier. Referenced by Laboratory.col_001 (many laboratory rows per patient).

col_002.name: sex
col_002.description: Sex: F (1023), M (202), blank (13). Strong female predominance consistent with autoimmune/rheumatic disease cohorts.

col_004.name: diagnosis_date
col_004.description: Date of diagnosis/registration, concentrated 1991–1998. Could be first-visit or diagnosis date; the exact event is not distinguishable from the data.

col_005.name: onset_date
col_005.description: Disease onset or symptom-onset date (1972–1998, earlier and sparser than col_004, ~20% missing). Could alternatively be a follow-up/last-visit date, but earlier-than-diagnosis values favor onset.

col_006.name: rheumatoid_factor
col_006.description: Serology flag, likely rheumatoid factor (or ANA) result: '-' negative (713), '+' positive (488), '+(' weak/ambiguous positive (3), blank (34). Which antibody is not determinable from the data.

col_007.name: diagnosis
col_007.description: Diagnosis(es), free text with abbreviations of rheumatic/autoimmune diseases: SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus), SJS (Sjögren's syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis), BEHCET, PSS (progressive systemic sclerosis / primary Sjögren's), DM (dermatomyositis), PN (polyarteritis nodosa) etc.; multiple diagnoses comma-separated.
